string-array.name: app_description
string-array.item: This app was created by Smadja Eliana, Parker David, Do Hoang Hai, and Maara Vanessa Purici.
It is our final project for the Mobile Development course during our 5th semester in Computer Science at Dawson College.
BookWorm allows you to discover, explore, and enjoy a collection of books right at your fingertips!
Start your reading journey today and immerse yourself in the world of knowledge and stories!

string-array.name: how_to_use_steps
string-array.item: To see the available books, check out our library!
Once you’ve chosen a book, click on its cover.
This will take you to a new screen where you can:
View the table of contents, or
Search for a word in the book.
